lines.text: Jethro, the priest of Midian, hears what God did for Israel and takes in Zipporah and her two sons.
Jethro comes to Moses at the mountain of God, and Moses bows down and kisses him.
Jethro says the LORD is greater than all other gods and brings a peace offering to God.
Jethro advises Moses to appoint God-fearing, trustworthy men to judge minor cases while major issues come to Moses.
Moses chooses capable men from all Israel as leaders of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens, then sends Jethro to Egypt.

wrong_details.true: Jethro returned to his own land
